Shadow Hearts   |                                                  New Game+
     [W-2-18]      |
___ ___ ___ ___ ___|___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

By saving your clear data after beating the game and watching the credits, you
can now use that clear data to play the game in New Game+ mode. There are a few
benefits to playing in New Game+ mode:

1) You start the game with every Fusion that you earned the last game,
   including both Amon and the SeraphicRadiance.

2) Your Score (in the Command Menu) carries over on the right side, and you can
   compare your Score for this game against the one you earned last game.

3) If you have all 124 Monster Library entries from your last game (or even a
   combination of your last and current games), you can talk to Knowledgeable
   Carl when Sharon's Pit Fight becomes available, and he will give you the
   [_BLACKSILKPANTS_]. It is an accessory for Alice that increases her special
   defense and cuts special attack damage in half (and changes the color of her
   panties from pink to black!)
